title: Caption glyph tone follows the real background: no viewer override, Meadow follows its sky
context: Spec 7.31 told the build to mark the photo/video viewers and the full-screen Meadow as dark surfaces so the Windows caption glyphs turn light. Lane 1's second worker found that on sidebar platforms the viewer's top 42 points are a transparent drag band over the light title strip. I then found that the full-screen Meadow's scene covers the window and its daytime sky top is light (190, 210, 222). In both places, forced light glyphs would vanish.
options: Drop the viewer wrap, and make the Meadow wrap follow the sky's brightness
Give the caption buttons their own backing plate
outcome: Second option. DarkCaptionSurface gained `dark` and recounts on update. meadowSkyDarkensCaptions(skyTop) uses ThemeData.estimateBrightnessForColor, the same rule the phone full screen uses for its system bars. The viewer and meadow_full_screen.dart are back to HEAD. The garden_view.dart wiring is outside lane 1's write-set, so it is saved as ~/.mitosis/field-notes/windows-release/lead-meadow-sky-captions.patch and is pushed as a lead commit on mitosis/windows-desktop after the PR opens. The spec text for 7.31 still says viewers; the PR body must say so.
